title: IoT Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) Platform
full_description:
IoT Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) Platform: Designed and developed a
fully self-hosted, multi-tenant IoT Backend-as-a-Service platform supporting MQTT, HTTP,
BLE, and custom LoRa communication protocols. Implemented real-time telemetry
processing, WebSocket monitoring, event-driven microservices architecture, device
authentication, and PostgreSQL-based scalable data management using Dockerized
deployment
